mapper.select: select c.id, c.type as platform_type, c.corp_name as cfg_name, c.corp_id, c.qy as cfg_enable, c.root_dept_id, c.root_dept_key, rt.dept_name as root_dept_name from ${cfgTable} c left join ${deptTmpTable} rt on rt.corpid = c.corp_id and rt.type = c.type and ((rt.wx_dept_key is not null and rt.wx_dept_key = c.root_dept_key) or (rt.wx_dept_key is null and rt.wx_dept_id = c.root_dept_id)) order by c.type, c.corp_name, c.id
